sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Transformer：縮放點積注意力
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付相似度矩陣、穩定softmax及溫度校準表。；兩機率值誤差小於1e−6，列欄損失方向與配對索引皆有測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver similarity matrices, stable softmax and temperature calibration.; Both probabilities agree within1e−6, with tests for loss direction and pairing indices.
related.difference: 畫Q的Lq×dk、K的Lk×dk、V的Lk×dv及Lq×Lk分數矩陣，標softmax軸。；分數2與1吻合，矩陣乘法shape成立，遮罩及機率和測試通過。
related.differenceEn: Draw Q,K,V shapes and the Lq×Lk score matrix, labeling the softmax axis.; Scores2 and1 match, matrix shapes agree and mask/sum tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩候選相似度差Δ以溫度τ形成p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ))；僅為一列二候選示例。；教學相似度.8與.2，τ=.2，改τ=.4。；p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574；τ.4得.817574。
分數s=q·k/√dk；單一分數不是機率，需與其他有效key一起softmax。；教學q·k=8,dk=16；保持內積8改dk64作尺度對照。；s=8/√16=2；dk64時s=1。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For two candidates with similarity gap Δ, p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ)); this is one row of a two-candidate example.; Teaching similarities.8 and.2, τ=.2 then.4.; p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574; τ.4 gives.817574.
Score s=q·k/√dk; a score is not a probability until softmax across valid keys.; Teaching dot product8,dk16; hold dot product8 while changing dk64.; s=8/√16=2; dk64 gives s=1.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Switch Transformer：專家路由與容量
related.titleEn: Switch Transformer: expert routing and capacity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付相似度矩陣、穩定softmax及溫度校準表。；兩機率值誤差小於1e−6，列欄損失方向與配對索引皆有測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver similarity matrices, stable softmax and temperature calibration.; Both probabilities agree within1e−6, with tests for loss direction and pairing indices.
related.difference: 列128token的top1路由，教學負載[50,30,28,20]；將40容量畫成四個佇列。；40及48容量正確，溢位10及2可重現，所有有效token去向可追蹤。
related.differenceEn: Route128 tokens top-one with teaching loads[50,30,28,20]; draw four queues of capacity40.; Capacities40/48 and overflow10/2 reproduce, and every valid token is traceable.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 兩候選相似度差Δ以溫度τ形成p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ))；僅為一列二候選示例。；教學相似度.8與.2，τ=.2，改τ=.4。；p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574；τ.4得.817574。
每專家名義容量C=fT/E，實作需明定取整；總容量充足不保證每個專家不溢位。；教學T128,E4,f1.25；改f1.5，兩案恰整數。；C=1.25×128/4=40；f1.5時48。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For two candidates with similarity gap Δ, p=1/(1+exp(−Δ/τ)); this is one row of a two-candidate example.; Teaching similarities.8 and.2, τ=.2 then.4.; p=1/(1+exp(−3))=.952574; τ.4 gives.817574.

Nominal expert capacity C=fT/E requires an explicit rounding policy; sufficient total capacity does not prevent individual overload.; Teaching T128,E4,f1.25 then1.5, both integral.; C=1.25×128/4=40; f1.5 gives48.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
